attribution.reason: Cell predates payload-sourced attribution (2026-09-18). Its release label came from the HOST's `claude --version`, while the payload it judges was written by whichever live session refreshed first — on this mixed-version host those can be different releases.
attribution.why_not: The probe's EXIT trap rm -f's the capture, and the cell records the payload's key NAMES but never its version VALUE. Nothing on disk can settle it after the fact.
attribution.supersedes_when: Overwritten by a payload-attributed re-run at this release; the marker going away is correct — the uncertain observation no longer occupies the slot.
